answer.says: The Ring Road? I do not know that name. I was only walking here, among the tombs. The traffic, I am told, is the lifeblood of the city; I prefer to let my own blood move.
answer.thought: She mistakes my walk for a journey, a confusion of the static and the dynamic that is common to all who have not yet grasped the dialectic of space. I am not stuck; I am in motion, which is the very point of the exercise. The air is cool now, a reprieve from the midday furnace, and her presence offers a small, pleasant interruption to the solitude of my thoughts.
